summary: Genuine coverage: StopButtonTests injects late events post-stop (isSuppressingStoppedTurnEvents path) and drives a real fake-RPC subprocess through stop+abort and stop-then-restart races (processGeneration gating), asserting no append/merge of the stopped turn's text or tool activity; ActiveWorkUITests confirms via real accessibilityIdentifier that no transcript.assistantMessage element appears after Stop. Counterexamples (late event after stop, late event after a new turn already started, partial-append onto existing bubble) are all exercised and rejected; no tautology/over-mocking/keyword theater found.
